NewOwnership(address,address).notice: Emitted when a new owner/governor has accepted their role

NewPauseGuardian(address,address).notice: Emitted when the pause guardian is changed

NewPendingOwnership(address,address).notice: Emitted when a new owner/governor has been set, but is pending acceptance

PartialPauseChanged(bool).notice: Emitted when the partial pause state changed

PauseChanged(bool).notice: Emitted when the full pause state changed

SetContractProxy(bytes32,address).notice: Emitted when the proxy address for a protocol contract has been set

acceptOwnership().notice: Admin function for pending governor to accept role and update governor. This function must called by the pending governor.

getContractProxy(bytes32).notice: Get contract proxy address by its id

lastPausePartialTime().notice: Timestamp for the last time the partial pause was set

lastPauseTime().notice: Timestamp for the last time the full pause was set

partialPaused().notice: Getter to access partial pause status

pauseGuardian().notice: Pause guardian is a separate entity from the governor that can pause and unpause the protocol, fully or partially

pendingGovernor().notice: Address of the new governor that is pending acceptance

setContractProxy(bytes32,address).notice: Register contract id and mapped address

setPartialPaused(bool).notice: Change the partial paused state of the contract Partial pause is intended as a partial pause of the protocol

setPaused(bool).notice: Change the paused state of the contract Full pause most of protocol functions
